stages.effectText: Gains 25% Sanctuary when HP is below 50%
Gains up to +60 ASPD and SP recovery rate +2.2/s Tenacity (reaches maximum bonus when losing 60% of Max HP)
Gains up to +70 ASPD and SP recovery rate +2.3/s Tenacity (reaches maximum bonus when losing 50% of Max HP)
When defeated, does not retreat and instead recovers 30% HP (can only activate once every deployment)
Attacks have a 20% chance to restore 1 SP and increase ATK to 110% for that attack; increased to a 75% chance if below 50% HP
Attacks have a 20% chance to restore 1 SP and increase ATK to 120% for that attack; increased to a 80% chance if below 50% HP
